blocks.x: How did you live in Chicago while you were playing there?
Well, I lived several different places. I, where did I live? I lived at the Congress Hotel on Harrison and Wabash Avenue. That's an old time. It is probably out of business. Why not too?
Well, Congress is still going, but it's extended all the way over on Michigan now.
Uh, this hotel was on Wabash on the northwest corner.
All right. Well, now it's extending all the way to Michigan Avenue.

No, did I say Congress? That's not the, no, that's not the name of it. That's not the name of it. I can't. You were near, near your place of work. Well, about six blocks. I can't think right offhand, uh, what the name of that hotel was. Commercial. Commercial. That's the name of it. That's the name now.
